headline: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 rises from 6.07% to 7.17% matched code
summary: Ratchet: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 advanced from 6.07% to 7.17% matched code, with 5,435 of 18,085 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The largest batch, #83, brings 938 NTSC-U functions over from already-matched PAL twins and same-game siblings.
highlights: PAL work includes six table and state helpers (#77), 53 resident game functions (#81), and one further function (#82).
Another 57 PAL resident functions landed through #84 and 54 through #85, covering state changes, resources, inventory and callbacks.
Twenty-one PAL-only functions using floating-point constants landed through #55. These PAL batches are separate from the NTSC-U v1.00 code percentage.
